shared_statement_en: The 120 curated dataset packages cover 33 broad organ/organ-structure classes under an explicit aggregation scheme. These classes comprise 24 named-organ categories and nine organ/structure classes; they are not a count of individual organs, whole-organ specimens, or distinct anatomical subsites. Cervix is counted with uterus; caecum, colon, rectum and appendix with large intestine; jaw bones with bones; and diaphragm with skeletal muscles. Navigation retains 64 more detailed anatomical, tissue-source, model/reference and unresolved categories, with 220 project-category memberships. A project can occur in several categories and is counted once by exact Project ID. Measured-material classifications comprise 68 tissue projects, 35 cell-line projects, 15 primary-cell projects, and two projects combining cell lines and primary cells. Organ origin of a cell model does not establish that organ tissue was measured. The six model/reference navigation groups do not enumerate all individual cell lines. PXD012845 remains unresolved at the selected-column level; thymus is not added from unmatched project-level metadata.

limitations: Not a fresh review of all source publications.
Rollup classes are a declared atlas reporting convention, not a universal anatomical organ inventory.
Collection sites can be metastases or surface/capsular specimens; presence does not imply primary cancer or normal organ parenchyma.
Caecum in PXD030034 is retained as caecum in source metadata and is included in the large-intestine rollup; it must not be relabelled colon.
The 33-class rollup supplements the 64 navigation tags; it does not replace or rename ZIP files.
